event_description: Explore supplied DeFi stress branches as declared loss and health-indicator shocks. No lending protocol, oracle, collateral, interest, liquidation or chain transaction is implemented.

personas.name: Risk scenario reviewer
personas.description: Applies explicit stress rules and declared payoffs. This actor has no wallet, funding, execution authority or inferred financial strategy.

probability_provenance.rationale: Illustrative 20% stress mixture; no calibration, market forecast or source verification is claimed.
Illustrative conditional severity given the supplied stress event; not a liquidation model or empirically estimated risk.

assumptions: Declared USD payoff is an illustrative metric, not withdrawable cash or financial settlement.
The supplied conditional severity draw depends on market-stress eligibility; named draws are independent conditional on declared dependencies.
Health-indicator basis points are an arbitrary supplied scale and are not a protocol health-factor calculation.
The declared loss branches are 0, 10000 or 40000 USD payoff units. No transfer or conservation-of-cash claim applies.
Change both complementary probabilities explicitly when changing the stress mixture; the engine fills no defaults.
